vendor: Semrush (SEMrush Inc. / Semrush Holdings, now an Adobe company)
product_family: Semrush One — unified SEO, AI search visibility, content, traffic/market intelligence, local, advertising, social, and PR platform (SaaS), plus Enterprise tier (Enterprise SEO/AIO/SI), App Center marketplace, and a public API

certifications.name: PCI DSS Level 1
certifications.proof_quote: We have fully implemented and support all processes related to PCI DSS compliance. Once a year, we confirm our compliance by passing an independent QSA audit. As a result, we have achieved a PCI DSS Level 1 certificate.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Semrush's products adhere to GDPR requirements effective May 25, 2018.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Not stated on Semrush's own security/legal pages as reviewed (2026-06-27). Third-party aggregators (Nudge Security, UpGuard) describe Semrush as SOC 2 audited, but no SOC 2 claim or report link was found on the vendor's own domain to confirm with a direct quote.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Not stated on Semrush's own security/legal pages as reviewed (2026-06-27). ISO 27001 appears only in third-party write-ups, not in a vendor-domain statement, so it cannot be confirmed.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No HIPAA claim on vendor security or legal pages. Semrush is a marketing/SEO platform not positioned for PHI; HIPAA is not advertised.

privacy.ai_training_note: Semrush AI Services Terms state directly: 'Semrush does not train or develop its models, and does not allow its third-party providers to train or develop its models on User Input.' Customers retain rights: 'You retain all rights you may have in User Input.' For Mailbox (Gmail/Outlook) integration data, the Privacy Policy says it is used only to provide the tool features, is stored encrypted, is not used for advertising, and human access is restricted. Note: AI Generative Services are 'not intended to collect personal data' and users are told not to submit personal data into them.
privacy.data_region: Controller is SEMrush Inc. (US-based). Privacy Policy describes international transfers of personal data and processing on behalf of business customers as a processor under the customer agreement (DPA). Specific data-residency / region-pinning options not documented on public pages.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 or higher (HTTPS) everywhere on the website with industry-standard algorithms and certificates; personal data encrypted in transit

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption for secure data storage in data centers

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration tests; internal security team additionally pentests new features weekly per release policy

security.name: Bug bounty
security.value: Active bug bounty program on HackerOne inviting independent researchers to disclose security flaws

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based, need-to-know access to personal data; SSO + 2FA for apps processing critical data; staff use VPN; activity logged to a SIEM

security.name: Physical / data center security
security.value: Data centers carry best-practice compliance certificates; 24/7 monitoring, CCTV on server-room access points, electronic intrusion detection, strict personnel access control

products.name: Semrush One (core SaaS)
products.category: SEO + AI search visibility, content, traffic/market analytics
products.data_scope: Account profile data, billing/payment info (PCI scope), project domains, keywords, crawled site data; product analytics via cookies/Google Analytics
products.notes: Self-serve and team plans; primary consumer-of-record is SEMrush Inc. under the Privacy Policy

products.name: Semrush Enterprise (Enterprise SEO / Enterprise AIO / Enterprise SI)
products.data_scope: Same platform data at larger scale, contracted under custom subscription agreement; Semrush acts as processor with a DPA for business-customer data
products.notes: Enterprise contracts governed by the customer agreement, not just the website Privacy Policy

products.name: Mailbox integration (Gmail / Outlook / Exchange)
products.data_scope: OAuth API token, email subject/body, replies, recipient/sender, thread/message IDs, send/open/reply metadata — stored encrypted
products.notes: Explicitly NOT used for advertising; human read access restricted; user can revoke and delete at any time. Highest-sensitivity data flow on the platform

products.name: Semrush AI / Generative Services
products.category: AI content and AI visibility tooling
products.data_scope: User Input (text/images/data submitted to generative tools)
products.notes: Governed by Semrush Artificial Intelligence Services Terms; no model training on User Input; users own their input; users told not to submit personal data

products.name: Semrush API + App Center
products.category: Developer API and third-party app marketplace
products.data_scope: API access to platform data; App Center apps subject to separate App Center Terms and security requirements
products.notes: Third-party apps have their own data scopes; review per-app before procurement

compare.pricing_model: Subscription SaaS (7-day free trial; tiered self-serve plans plus custom-quoted Enterprise)
compare.data_residency: US-based controller (SEMrush Inc.) with documented international transfers; no public region-pinning option found

flags: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 are widely attributed to Semrush by third-party aggregators (Nudge Security, UpGuard) but were NOT confirmable with a direct quote on Semrush's own domain as of 2026-06-27 — marked unknown, not held.

Ownership change: Adobe has completed acquisition of Semrush (per Semrush newsroom). Long-term compliance/data-handling posture may shift under Adobe; re-verify trust center and DPA after integration.
Mailbox (Gmail/Outlook) integration is the most sensitive data flow and should be flagged for buyers who connect mailboxes.
